findings.radius64: No newly generated target person is visible in the selected ROI; fill retains a conspicuous hazy person-shaped region with little plausible photographic background detail. Semantic progress only, fails overall photographic reconstruction.
findings.radius192: No newly generated target person is visible in the selected ROI; conspicuous hazy shape/background mismatch remains. Fails overall photographic reconstruction.
findings.decision: Wider generation holes avoid the replacement-person failure on this one case, but neither is acceptable photographic removal. No model or mask policy admitted.

encoding_observation.method: Existing reversible signed-log Rec2020-to-sRGB research encoding
encoding_observation.finding: Neutral scene black maps near0.325 in this model domain. A photographic-contrast reversible encoding is worth testing. This observation does not prove the cause of the haze or establish a color/noise acceptance result.

limitations: No production model admission, mask defaults, UI/runtime, accepted XMP, asset encoding, rendering/export path or native context cap changes.
One public RAW, visually reviewed instance mask, no independent closure/role labels, person model releases or hidden-background truth.
Known/protected pixel preservation is established for36 rendered grades; that does not establish photographic quality, color/hardware performance or release qualification.
Shared M5 Max128 GiB host; uncontrolled timing and memory observations, no supported-device-tier p50/p95 claim.
Qwen Image Edit is a separate candidate under download/provenance review, not executed or accepted by this record.
All licensing/conversion/distribution and full product/native-context/portable-runtime gates remain.
